text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, you're checking the menu.
Hehe, such a serious look.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...Just the same as always, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...Phew.
choice_data_list: Buena, got a moment?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...! Yes.
Is the break over already?
choice_data_list: No, I just wondered if something w...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Ah... no, nothing's wrong at all!
It's just getting warm,
you know? I zoned out for a second.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it,
we have pool training next, right?
I'm so glad!
It's going to feel amazing diving in right
now.
choice_data_list: (She's tense... If she can't talk ...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? A day off?
Yeah, my schedule's open. What's up?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Wait,
really? You want to visit our hometown?
Together with me...?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... It's been so long...! 
—Ah, look! That bookstore over there.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
We went there to buy study guides together,
remember?
And then we bought croquettes at that butcher
shop and split them half-and-half...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...It's totally unchanged.
choice_data_list: —Let's take a stroll around for ol...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Hehe,
the grass is still just as overgrown.
This place hasn't changed either, huh?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
We used to play hide-and-seek here all the
time.
Covering our eyes against that tree,
counting 'one... two...'

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
You always hid in the exact same spot.
...You were doing that on purpose for me,
weren't you?
choice_data_list: ...Who knows?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, keeping the truth a secret? ...Alright,
I won't press you on it.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...Also,
we used to pray at the shrine together a
lot.
For all sorts of things.

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text:
*sniffle* *sob*...
Please make big brother's scrapes...
...heal up fast...!
choice_data_list: Please let it heal cleanly so we c...

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text:
*sniffle* *sob*...
Please make big sister's scrapes...
...heal up fast...!
choice_data_list: Please let it heal cleanly so we c...

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text:
For tomorrow's Sports Day!
Please let the sun shine super bright!
Hnnngh...!
choice_data_list: Please give us nice weather so we ...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...Quite a few of our wishes came true,
didn't they?
Oh, why don't we go say thanks at the
shrine?
choice_data_list: Sounds good. The gods have been lo...
Sounds good. The gods have been lo...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Huh... really? Even recently?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...I see.
Well,
then we definitely have to go give our
thanks!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Ah!
Hello, ma'am! It's been a while.

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
Well if it isn't little Buena and company! My,
oh my,
you've both grown up so wonderfully~!
It's so lovely to see you again!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I'm so happy to see you too.
Um, do you still sell mugwort manju?

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
Of course I do! You always loved them,
didn't you? Want some today?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...! Yes, please!
Trainer, would you like the same?

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's right. I've got yokan too.
It's been your favorite lately, hasn't it,
young man?

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's right. I've got yokan too.
It's been your favorite lately, hasn't it,
young lady?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Huh, yokan...? 
Didn't you tell me before that you didn't
like it because it was too sweet...?
choice_data_list: I've come to appreciate that sweet...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...I see,
it really is delicious after all!
Then let's get some of that too!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...Oh, that shop closed down...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: —I see. This place too...
choice_data_list: ...Did coming here not cheer you u...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
! No, not at all. ...Wait, I get it now.
You were worried about me?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I was wondering why you invited me out here
out of the blue...
So that was why.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...Hey,
could we stop by the shrine one last time?
There's one more thing I want to wish for.
choice_data_list: ...Sure thing.

text_block_list.text: (Clatter, clatter——Clap, clap)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
(...I'm not a little kid anymore.
I'm going to grow up quickly.
I'll get over feeling lonely, too.)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
(So please watch over me.
So I won't make them look worried ever
again.
So I can show them a bright,
cheerful smile...!)
(——Clatter!)
choice_data_list: ...What was that sound just now?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Um, over this way... Ah, an ema fell down!
The string must have snapped...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Wait,
this handwriting—I've seen it before...

—Of course it looked familiar.
Because that was something I had written
not too long ago...!
choice_data_list: Ah, that's...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"May I become someone worthy of Buena."
...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, what does this mean?
Could you... tell me?

—I told her everything.
The shock of seeing how fast she ran after
growing up.
Studying desperately and even praying to
the gods just to stand beside an untouchable
flower...
choice_data_list: ...I wanted to make it happen no m...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...You were trying your hardest all this time,
holding those feelings inside?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...Even though we spent so much time
apart.
Even though so many things changed along
the way...
choice_data_list: But this one thing never changed.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
choice_data_list: I always wished to be by your side.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...We weren't apart after all.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
You were always the same person you've always
been...
Your heart was always right by my side...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, is there anything else?
choice_data_list: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Ah, hehe, sorry so sudden!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I just felt like asking.
...About the time you spent away from me.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: About the parts of you I don't know yet.
choice_data_list: ...Your smile finally came back.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry. I'm okay now.
...I finally graduated.
choice_data_list: Graduated... from what?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...Well, let's see.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
From being the "lonely little Buu-chan," I
guess!
